_note: Configure these as the agent's collected data fields in VaaniYantra. The webhook normaliser (src/lib/vaani/normalize.ts) accepts these keys plus common aliases; missing values stay null — never guessed.
project_type: residential | office | clinic | studio | hospitality | retail | fitness | other_commercial
location_status: in_area | outside — set in_area only if the caller confirmed it's in Pune city/PCMC
project_stage: string, e.g. 'new possession', 'lived-in', 'bare shell', 'possession in 6 weeks'
timeline_deadline: YYYY-MM-DD if the caller gave a completion date
later_start_ok: boolean — answer to 'would a later completion date work?'
requirements: style / special needs in the caller's words
unknown_fields: array of field names the caller didn't know
declined_fields: array of field names the caller preferred not to share
